items.informal_name: Algebra Equivalence of Polynomial Rings Induced by Coefficient Mapping
items.type:
{R : Type u} →
  {A : Type z} →
    {B : Type u_2} →
      [inst : CommSemiring R] →
        [inst_1 : Semiring A] →
          [inst_2 : Semiring B] →
            [inst_3 : Algebra R A] → [inst_4 : Algebra R B] → (A ≃ₐ[R] B) → Polynomial A ≃ₐ[R] Polynomial B
items.informal_description: Given a commutative semiring $ R $ and $ R $-algebras $ A $ and $ B $, if there exists an $ R $-algebra equivalence $ f : A ≃ₐ[R] B $, then the induced $ R $-algebra homomorphism from the polynomial ring $ A[X] $ to $ B[X] $ defined by applying $ f $ coefficient-wise is itself an algebra equivalence. This means the map $ \text{Polynomial.mapAlgHom}(f) : A[X] → B[X] $ is invertible, with inverse given by $ \text{Polynomial.mapAlgHom}(f^{-1}) $, establishing an isomorphism between the polynomial rings that preserves both ring operations and scalar multiplication by elements of $ R $.

items.informal_name: Algebra Equivalence between Multivariate Polynomials over Option σ and Polynomials in One Variable with Multivariate Coefficients
items.type:
∀ (R : Type u) {σ : Type u_1} [inst : CommSemiring R] (p : MvPolynomial (Option σ) R),
  ((MvPolynomial.optionEquivLeft R σ) p).natDegree = MvPolynomial.degreeOf none p
items.informal_description: There exists an algebra equivalence between the ring of multivariate polynomials with variables indexed by $\text{Option } \sigma$ (i.e., $\sigma \cup \{\text{none}\}$) and coefficients in a commutative semiring $R$, and the polynomial ring in one variable (corresponding to $\text{none}$) whose coefficients are multivariate polynomials over $R$ with variables indexed by $\sigma$. This equivalence maps variables in $\text{Option } \sigma$ to either the outer polynomial's indeterminate (for $\text{none}$) or coefficients in the inner multivariate polynomial ring (for $\text{some } s$), with the inverse given by renaming variables.

items.informal_name: Algebra Equivalence of Polynomial Rings Induced by Coefficient Mapping
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u} {A : Type z} {B : Type u_2} [inst : CommSemiring R] [inst_1 : Semiring A] [inst_2 : Semiring B]
  [inst_3 : Algebra R A] [inst_4 : Algebra R B] (f : A ≃ₐ[R] B), ⇑(Polynomial.mapAlgEquiv f) = Polynomial.map ↑f
items.informal_description: Given a commutative semiring $ R $ and $ R $-algebras $ A $ and $ B $, if there exists an $ R $-algebra equivalence $ f : A ≃ₐ[R] B $, then the induced $ R $-algebra homomorphism from the polynomial ring $ A[X] $ to $ B[X] $ defined by applying $ f $ coefficient-wise is itself an algebra equivalence. This means the map $ \text{Polynomial.map}(f) : A[X] → B[X] $ is invertible, with inverse given by $ \text{Polynomial.map}(f^{-1}) $, establishing an isomorphism between the polynomial rings that preserves both ring operations and scalar multiplication by elements of $ R $.

items.informal_name: Algebra equivalence between multivariate polynomials over Option σ and polynomials in one variable with multivariate coefficients
items.type: (R : Type u) → (S₁ : Type v) → [inst : CommSemiring R] → MvPolynomial (Option S₁) R ≃ₐ[R] Polynomial (MvPolynomial S₁ R)
items.informal_description: The algebra equivalence between the ring of multivariate polynomials with variables indexed by $\text{Option } \sigma$ and coefficients in a commutative semiring $R$, and the polynomial ring in one variable whose coefficients are multivariate polynomials over $R$ with variables indexed by $\sigma$. This equivalence is constructed by evaluating variables in $\text{Option } \sigma$ as either the indeterminate of the outer polynomial ring (for the $\text{none}$ case) or coefficients in the inner multivariate polynomial ring (for the $\text{some } s$ cases), with the inverse given by substituting the renamed variables.

items.informal_name: Coefficient correspondence in algebra equivalence between multivariate polynomials over Option σ and polynomials in one variable with multivariate coefficients
items.type:
∀ (R : Type u) (S₁ : Type v) [inst : CommSemiring R] (n : Option S₁ →₀ ℕ) (f : MvPolynomial (Option S₁) R),
  MvPolynomial.coeff n.some (((MvPolynomial.optionEquivLeft R S₁) f).coeff (n none)) = MvPolynomial.coeff n f
items.informal_description: For any finite support function $ n : \text{Option } \sigma \to₀ \mathbb{N} $ and polynomial $ f \in R[\text{Option } \sigma] $, the coefficient of the monomial corresponding to $ n $ restricted to $ \sigma $ in the polynomial obtained by evaluating the algebra equivalence at the variable corresponding to 'none' equals the coefficient of $ n $ in $ f $. Formally, $ \text{coeff}_{n.\text{some}}(\text{Polynomial.coeff}(\text{optionEquivLeft}(f), n(\text{none}))) = \text{coeff}_n(f) $.
